text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I heard that voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERBYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How many times have I been encouraged by her cheerful voice
as she earnestly looks ahead? But—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On this day, that voice sounded truly terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't it working...?
Why am I...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ti-cket-zo! Ti-cket-zo!
Ti-cket-zoo!! Ti-cket-zoo!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, waaaahhh...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!
I did it, I did it, I DID IIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!!
I did iiiiiiit~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket, congratulations on winning the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much!
I'm really, really, really happy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I worked so hard for this day.
Because I wanted to win no matter what.
I trained so, so much with everything I had."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Because I truly wanted to win...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll work even harder!
I'll keep giving you the best races ever!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "So please continue to support me going forward!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you saying... you can get even stronger than this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Unfortunately, I lost, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps still shaken by the shock of defeat,
Biwa Hayahide fell silent."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...How should I encourage her?
Suddenly, the situation overlaps with that time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That was after the Satsuki Sho.
Biwa Hayahide's expression clouded over—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's shoulders flinch. It seems her current worries
are connected to what happened back then.
choice_data_list: What have you been thinking since then?
What have you been thinking about since then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You really hit where it hurts,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I can't get it out of my head.
The vision of myself losing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"To Taishin in the Satsuki Sho,
and to Ticket in the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even after anticipating countless scenarios and running simulations over and over...
these girls always bring out 'something'
that completely exceeds them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I'm terrified.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
An unidentifiable presence.
If it wasn't an oversight, but a 'something' simply beyond reach... then what did I do to those girls...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Then let's add that "something" to the equation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: If it's Hayahide, I'm sure she can make it work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha—based on what? Besides, that "something" is way too vague, and we don't even have a concrete solution in sight, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is an exceptionally clever Umamusume.
Clever enough to figure out a solution all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...That is why, when faced with an obstacle, you try too hard to resolve it entirely within your own thoughts. However—"
choice_data_list: Let's try it anyway, just to see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: If we run enough tests, we might just find the answer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...To seek answers merely by repeating trials,
without formulating a hypothesis first.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What an arrogant, absurd argument.
It's reckless and completely irrational.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Only those truly desperate to see the formula completed
would dare test such a thing."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems you truly understand
the kind of Umamusume I am.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, I discussed things with
Biwa Hayahide in the waiting room for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did she feel the difference between herself and those two?
And how to counter it—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Based on the above, a priority matter
has emerged for our consideration.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It means possessing the “will to become strong.”
Just like back then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't go worrying over nothing.
I can still run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race too, didn't you?
She really was strong. It made me wanna win.
That's exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I worked so hard for this day.
Because I wanted to win no matter what.
I trained so, so much with everything I had."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...'A resolve that cares not what becomes of them.'
I'd like to hypothesize that this is what birthed their sheer drive."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm. And Trainer,
I have a request for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regarding what comes next, please do not fear.
I want you to push me through rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. I never want to taste defeat again.
I will push myself even harder...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Biwa Hayahide sprinted off once more,
armed with a new theory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will never... lose again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Along with an abnormal obsession.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next goal, the 'Kikuka Sho',
would be the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown route.
